purpose: Teach: 高架/岩石/邸宅/蜘蛛/蝉/コスモス/重油/広辞苑

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前の高架線路、電車が綺麗ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The elevated track in front of the shop—the trains are beautiful, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft, wondering voice. Eyes lifted toward the window. Pause before the dash—as if tracing the movement in real time. Warm, almost dreamy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、岩石採集が趣味なんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told me rock collecting is their hobby.
lines.style: Gentle, sharing-a-detail tone. Not gossiping—observing. Slight tilt of warmth, like Mei just noticed something worth knowing about this person.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、邸宅から徒歩でお見えになるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they walk here from their house every time.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the voice. Slow delivery. The wonder of someone's small, intentional habit. Trailing softly, like a small smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の隅に蜘蛛の巣があるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's a spider web in the corner of the shop.
lines.style: Light, dry observation. Not complaining—noticing. A beat of wry affection, like she's both amused and oddly fond of this small, persistent detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、夏の午後、蝉の鳴き声がBGMだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Summer afternoons here—the cicadas are basically the soundtrack.
lines.style: Reflective and poetic. Slower pace. Settling into the image. Voice carries the heat and sound of it. Slight contentment underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前にコスモスを咲かせたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd like to plant cosmos flowers out front one day.
lines.style: Quiet hopefulness. A small dream spoken aloud, but gently—not demanding anything. Warm and clear, like she can almost see it blooming.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、重油の運搬のお仕事だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer works in heavy oil transport, they said.
lines.style: Casual sharing of information, but with underlying respect for the work. Even-toned, not marveling—just noting something real about their life.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、広辞苑を毎日読んでらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They read the Kojien dictionary every single day.
lines.style: Admiration held close. Slow, careful delivery on the action itself. Voice quiets slightly—something touched by the devotion of it. Almost intimate in tone.
